text.p: These are the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Latif Nsayyif Jassem relieved of his post as minister of labour and social affairs.
- President Saddam Hussein chairs meeting which calls for adopting strict measures against usurers.
- Saddam exchanges congratulatory telegrams on New Year with world leaders.
(The above stories were carried by IRAQ and JUMHOURIYA)
- Turkish troops commit another massacre against Kurds in northern Iraq.
- In order to counter forgery the United States issues new $100 bank note.
